title: VIX futures & options October expiration (SOQ settlement) — the settlement that lands inside the FOMC blackout
source: EST: CBOE'S OWN SETTLEMENT FILE, fetched direct by the opex-2026-10-16 lane on 2026-09-09. cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv/?dt=2026-09-08 returned HTTP 200 and the rows `VX,VX/V6,2026-10-21,18.402` and `VXM,VXM/V6,2026-10-21,18.402` — the exchange dating and pricing its own October contract, alongside VX/U6 2026-09-16 (16.6283), VX/X6 2026-11-18 (19.1354) and VX/Z6 2026-12-16 (19.2512). DETERMINISTIC CROSS-CHECK, re-derived rather than assumed: VIX futures and options expire on the Wednesday 30 days before the third Friday of the FOLLOWING calendar month, so the settlement strikes a clean 30-day SPX strip. November 2026's third Friday is 2026-11-20 (November 1 2026 is a Sunday, so the Fridays are the 6th, 13th, 20th and 27th); 2026-11-20 minus 30 days is 2026-10-21, and 2026-10-21 is a WEDNESDAY — the exchange's file and the rule return the same date independently. Settlement is the special opening quotation (VRO) struck in the 9:30 a.m. ET opening auction, the standing convention this calendar's other vix-expiration entries already record and not a claim this session re-sourced. Filed estimate, not confirmed, for the same reason vix-expiration-2026-09-16 was when it was discovered: this lane may not self-confirm a date it found in its own adjacency sweep, and the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange's own settlement file. The promotion trigger is this id's own initial research reading cboe.com/tradable-products/vix/vix-futures/ or theocc.com direct. Discovered during the opex-2026-10-16 interval-elapsed pulse, checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED by the opex-2026-10-16 D37 adjacency sweep (2026-09-09). THE HOLE: this calendar tracks VIX expirations at 2026-09-16 and then jumps to 2027-01-20 — October, November and December 2026 are all missing. Only October's is proposed here, because it is the one inside this proposer's ±5-day corridor; the other two are a gap a later sweep should close on its own evidence, not something this file should backfill by pattern. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PROPOSER, and the direction is the surprising part: VIX AM-settles to the SOQ of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out, so VX/V6 (2026-10-21) settles off the 2026-11-20 strip, NOT off opex-2026-10-16. The link that actually binds the proposer runs the other way — the 2026-10-16 SPX series is the strip behind VX/U6 on 2026-09-16, a month BEFORE its own expiration, which means the October monthly chain carries a vol-complex hedging job well ahead of opex week. WHERE THIS ONE SITS: 2026-10-21 is the third session inside the confirmed 2026-10-17 -> 2026-10-29 FOMC communications blackout (fomc-blackout-start-2026-10-17), and the 30-day window it prices (2026-10-21 -> 2026-11-20) contains the 2026-10-28 decision — so it fixes its settlement level in an opening auction five sessions before that decision with the official interpretation channel closed. It also shares the day with treasury-20y-bond-2026-10-21, treasury-buyback-tips-1y10y-2026-10-21 and ecb-quiet-period-start-2026-10-21. THE ONE THING NOT TO CONCLUDE: none of that geometry is measured here, and the proposer's own finding runs against reading edge into expiration mechanics — its 2026-09-09 pulse measured the monthly expiration-day volume separation at 0.11 (n=91, 2015+) against 1.08 for quarterlies, and found the vendor post-opex 'window of weakness' absent in SPY on both returns (P = 0.716) and realized vol (P = 0.463). A lane taking this id should treat the in-blackout settlement as a QUESTION to measure against the other tracked expirations, not an edge it has inherited. Impact low matches every other vix-expiration entry; symbols is empty and no house playbook is calendar-keyed. Proposed as an estimate — estimates widen caution only and nothing here licenses an entry.
